verdict.rationale: Browserbase deploys and runs browser agents, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a fair axis for it. The pack documents no versioning, version history, or rollback of agents or automations. The Optimize tool, which turns a run into a Stagehand script or a better prompt, and session replay or logs for reviewing runs are adjacent features. Keeping exported scripts in a user's own version control would be a user-side workaround, not a product capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
